size.$description: Width and height of the checkbox box.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the checkbox box.

default.$description: Background of the unchecked checkbox box at rest.

selected.$description: Fill of the checked and indeterminate checkbox box; also drawn as its border so fill and edge stay in sync. AA-checked against checkbox.mark via the on-accent pair.

selected-hover.$description: Fill of the checked and indeterminate checkbox box on hover and while pressed; AA-checked against checkbox.mark via the on-accent pair.

default.$description: Border of the unchecked checkbox box at rest.

invalid.$description: Border of the unchecked checkbox box when validation fails.

mark.$description: Color of the check and indeterminate marks on the selected fill.
